Misconception: "Ignoring available order" (search.linear-scan-when-ordered). Also "Asymptotically slower than required" (cx.asymptotic-gap). Possibly also "Mixed interval conventions"? No, they used linear scan, not interval. So main misconceptions: search.linear-scan-when-ordered, cx.asymptotic-gap. Provide confidence high, maybe 0.9 for both. Order most likely first: search.linear-scan-when-ordered (0.95). Then cx.asymptotic-gap (0.85).
